description: SignTool can see a certificate only from an elevated prompt because the build account lacks private-key access, based on https://stackoverflow.com/questions/56563732/why-does-signtool-exe-only-find-certificate-when-run-as-admin.
prompt:
I'm setting up a new dev laptop and our normal build can't sign `Orbit.Reporting.dll` unless I start the developer command prompt as admin. The cert is visible in my Personal certificates.

After Private Key filter, 0 certs were left.
SignTool Error: No certificates were found that met all the given criteria.
